title: Ledger: form view `modalSize` keeps `live` after #36425 deleted its only named reader — re-audit (enforce-or-remove)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from the #36425 dev's report (`open_questions[0]` and `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, PR #36543). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

`packages/spec/liveness/view.json` → `form.modalSize` is `status: live`, verified 2026-10-28. Its note names one Console reader: the New / Edit record dialog, which copied `modalSize` from the object's internal form view.

PR #36543 (#36425) retires that read. Record create and edit no longer load an internal form view, and the dialog derives its own size. A named or public form opens on a full page (`FormPage`, `/forms/NAME`), not in a dialog. So after #36543 merges, no reader of `modalSize` **on a form view** is named. `ModalForm.tsx` still has a `modalSize` prop, but that is the block's own prop, not a form-view key.

PR #36543 rewrites the note to say "RE-AUDIT OWED" and deliberately leaves the status alone. Flipping a ledger verdict is the ledger owner's call, not that card's.

## Why it matters

A key the ledger calls `live` but that nothing reads is the declared-but-not-enforced shape ADR-0049 forbids. An author, or an AI writing metadata, sets `modalSize` on a form view and nothing happens.

## Ask

Re-audit `form.modalSize`. Also check any sibling key that only a dialog ever read. Then either name a live reader or retire the key through the enforce-or-remove route (`spec-property-retirement` playbook). The dev recommends the re-audit (option A) because the only cited reader is gone.

## Likely lane

`domain:spec` (ledger, schema, retirement). It might have a ui half if a dialog reader is found.

## Re-check

`grep -n "RE-AUDIT OWED" packages/spec/liveness/view.json`: a hit on `main` means #36543 has merged and the re-audit is still owed. Until then, this card waits on #36543.
